name: Parasol
definition: Hand-held umbrella made to shade its carrier from the sun, with a canopy of lace, paper, silk or sun-blocking fabric not made to shed rain; folding or stick shaft is an attribute.
reason: Sold under its own name (Kohl's "Sun Parasol"); canopy form and purpose differ from rain umbrellas; memo §3 and R-121 left it unplaced.

reason: An umbrella made for rain and sun keeps its mechanism home; only a canopy not made for rain is A4.7.07.

name: Inverted umbrella
definition: Umbrella with a double canopy that closes upward and inside out, so the wet outer face folds inward.
reason: Different opening mechanism, the sub-family axis; guide lists it as its own type; memo expected 8-14 umbrella and fan kinds.
Vented double canopy is a wind feature on golf, stick or compact umbrellas, not a form (C2(b)).
Ultra-flat folding umbrella is a compact umbrella; thinness is a size attribute (C6).
Memo and tree: automatic opening is an attribute of every umbrella kind.

name: Packing cube
definition: Zipped fabric case packed inside luggage to hold and compress clothes, sold in sets of sizes.
reason: Travel container with no home (not made for one bag, so not A4.10); Wikipedia Baggage lists packing cubes; Rimowa organisers.

name: Luggage tag

reason: Accessory serving bags with no home; harvest shows Weigh To Go tag; no harvester page for plain tags: attest in HV_A4_NK.
